call_qa_forensic_highlights.topic: Consulting Demand Softness vs. Competitive Market Share
call_qa_forensic_highlights.question: Can you unpack the divergence between your solid Software performance and near-flat Consulting growth? Are clients pausing broader IT programs to fund GenAI, or are you losing market share to offshore systems integrators?
call_qa_forensic_highlights.executive_response: CEO Arvind Krishna clarified that the consulting slowdown is an industry-wide prioritization phenomenon rather than a competitive loss. Clients are scrutinizing discretionary consulting projects and re-allocating capital toward infrastructure readiness. However, IBM's watsonx book of business exceeded $3.0B, roughly 80% of which flows through consulting contracts over a 12-to-18 month implementation cycle.

call_qa_forensic_highlights.topic: Mainframe Cycle Timing and z17 Launch Expectations
call_qa_forensic_highlights.question: Infrastructure declined 7% as the z16 cycle heads into its 10th quarter. When do you anticipate the inflection to next-generation mainframe hardware, and how will that alter margin mix in 2027?
call_qa_forensic_highlights.executive_response: CFO James Kavanaugh highlighted that z16 performance remains one of the strongest mainframe cycles in IBM history, outperforming the prior z15 cycle on cumulative revenue. He noted that hardware cyclicality is normal and anticipated, with next-gen systems typically debuting in a 3-year rhythm, while high-margin software maintenance contracts remain sticky.

call_qa_forensic_highlights.topic: Free Cash Flow Bridge & Finance Lease Obligations
call_qa_forensic_highlights.question: You raised full-year reported FCF to >$13.0B, yet in Q3 working capital and lease commitments created a substantial delta in True FCF. How should institutional investors model net leverage and capital returns?
call_qa_forensic_highlights.executive_response: Management reiterated commitment to maintaining its growing dividend (30+ consecutive years of increases) and accelerating debt reduction following strategic acquisitions. The cash generation profile in Q4 is historically the highest of the year, driven by annual enterprise software renewals and deferred revenue collections.
